header.name: PracticeCrystalSimBot BP
header.description: Crystal PvP practice bot as SimulatedPlayer. Requires Beta APIs experiment ON. v0.5.4: hard preset keeps 0-value cooldowns (tag parser no longer reverts 0 to saved values); stuck detection counts jump-in-place so hole escape ladder (detour/mine/pillar/TP) actually triggers; blast-mitigation block placement tamed (preempt only when target armed in mainhand within 5.5 blocks, 8s CD; projectile protection 40t and skipped while shield guard; never place into own cell); post-dive navigation reset; hard bowDistance 10. v0.5.3: removed the un-namespaced "bot" command registration that current engines reject (NoNamespace); /bot resolves via the pvpbot:bot alias. v0.5.2: fixed /bot failing with "run from a player" — command handler now resolves the caller from CustomCommandOrigin.sourceEntity instead of the single-real-player heuristic. v0.5.1: Phase-1 fixes — replaced nonexistent SimulatedPlayer.attack/interact with real attackEntity/interactWithBlock, loadout sync keeps weapons, self-damage capped by HP, armor model corrected, dive exclusive during flight.
